items.summaryOriginal: As production agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore process multi-megabyte JSON payloads, token costs and latency climb. This post shares three composable strategies: offloading heavy artifacts to Amazon S3, on-demand result paging, and dictionary compaction. Together they cut per-turn token use by up to 71% and latency by up to 80%.
